name: Angry Birds Cheetos 2
summary: The sequel to the original Cheetos promotional game, released in 2013 to promote the snack brand in Turkey and Russia. The pigs steal the birds' Cheetos, leading to a chase into space. The game features nine levels—three available for free and six "premium" levels unlocked using credits earned by entering codes from specially marked Frito-Lay products. The key gameplay addition is an enhanced Cheetos Bag power-up that explodes on impact, offering a new strategic element for destroying pig structures.
